segments.he: א' מאנ"ש אמר פעם להאיש שהי' לומד ברבים תנו לו תורה כזו שאוכל ליקח אותו לכיסו לכם ולילך אחר לשוק "גיט ?? אזא תורה איך זמל קמין מארגין זיין מיט איהר אין גאס:
segments.en: The poor man thought this was a second house belonging to the man he had worked for — that after working at the first house, one goes to the second to eat. The moment he entered, servants came out to receive him, washed him, and immediately set the table with all manner of foods and delicacies — all with great honor, as a servant before his master. In the middle of the meal he said: "All this toil was worth it!" The generous host replied: "My dear friend — what toil did you do here with me? You did not toil here at all!" And he told him about the miser he had worked for. The host said: "Ir hot geharvet umzist un ir est umzist — dort voo ir hot geharvet, est ir nit, un dort voo ir est, hot ir nit geharvet" [You toiled in vain and you eat in vain — where you toiled you do not eat, and where you eat you did not toil].
